c1.prompt: Instrumental medieval folk music for a cozy village life game. Period instruments only: lute, recorder, kaval flute, hurdy-gurdy, frame drum, bagpipe, lyre, harp. No piano, no synthesizer, no electric guitar, no modern drum kit, no vocals. Gentle, warm spring morning on a small farm. Lute and recorder carry a simple folk melody, soft frame drum, light and hopeful, relaxed tempo around 90 BPM, loops naturally back to the start.
